en: An old Spanish postal card with printed red text and coat of arms reading 'TARJETA POSTAL' and 'ESPAÑA', bearing a red 10 centimos stamp with cancellation marks. Blue crayon markings and black ink handwriting address the card to a recipient in Madrid. A rectangular postmark at the bottom right reads 'DISTRITO 14' with a date and routing text. The card is slightly yellowed, showing age spots and wear.
